answer: Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The summit graph is validated at intake and the karst frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and falcon anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Scaling up is where the attack dies: 1282 fake identities need 612 separate proofs, each held 46 days, so the bill grows in a straight line while the reward stays flat. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
